scope: Synthetic data, named pasteboards, isolated settings and temporary history. Live popover probe uses its own windows. Carbon events target this test process only; no global input is sent.
limits: Repeated deterministic inputs are not unique random cases. The old suite passing does not cover the newly reproduced interleavings.

Round-end and peak physical footprint describe a synthetic test process, not normal application usage or a hard memory cap. Expanded UI coverage makes old/new run times unsuitable for a performance comparison.
Zero leaks applies only to the listed instrumented runs; reachable caches and untested paths may remain.
macOS 15 and 10.15 hardware, physical mouse dragging and real Word/WPS/Pages application flows remain outside this local verification.
